_about: Study areas. bbox is west,south,east,north (degrees). states are matched to geoBoundaries ADM1 names (any alias). clip: true keeps only districts whose centre lies inside bbox (for part of a state). AI disclosure: drafted with Claude (Anthropic).

regions.name: Punjab & Haryana
regions.story: Rice-straw burning after the October harvest, and wheat stubble in April and May.

regions.name: Western Uttar Pradesh
regions.story: The eastern end of the rice-wheat belt, with the same October to November stubble season.

regions.name: Madhya Pradesh
regions.story: Wheat residue burning that peaks from March to May, plus fires in its forests.

regions.name: Mizoram & Manipur
regions.story: Shifting cultivation (jhum): hill plots cleared by fire, peaking in March and April.

regions.name: Uttarakhand
regions.story: Himalayan forest fires in the dry pre-monsoon months, April to June.

regions.name: Odisha & Chhattisgarh
regions.story: Forest fires in the dry season, late February to April, across the sal forests of central-east India.

regions.name: Assam & neighbours
regions.story: Assam, Meghalaya, Nagaland and Tripura: shifting cultivation and grassland fires in the hills, peaking February to April.
